text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the RFC on streaming retries and resume. Proposing a small observer protocol between gateway <-> runtime so the edge can decide resume vs restart. TL;DR: add an opt-in header `X-RW-Stream-Trace` carrying opaque checkpoints and minimal metadata. Thoughts?
mike: high-level +1. How do we expose checkpoints without coupling to model internals?
elaine: Checkpoint should be an opaque token produced by the runtime. Gateway stores last-seen checkpoint per client connection. On retry, client/gateway includes last-checkpoint and a `resume-request` flag so runtime can choose resume or full replay.
jasper: Concern: replay safety and duplication. Resume could re-send tokens/chunks. Runtime needs dedupe at chunk-level.
sangeeta: We already have request-id dedupe. For streaming we should include (request-id, chunk-offset, sig) in the checkpoint. HMAC to prevent tampering.
mike: HMAC => key mgmt questions (per-tenant vs global).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary runtime v2 with resume support scheduled at 12:00 UTC
elaine: Example header we want:

```
X-RW-Stream-Trace: v1;req=abcd1234;chk=ckpt-42;model=v1.3;sig=MEUCIQ...
X-RW-Resume: true
```

elaine: Also propose initial handshake trailer `stream-resume-supported: true` so gateways know runtime capability.
jasper: Edge MUST avoid resume if model-version differs or if fallback occurred. Resume only valid for same model binary + tokenizer.
sangeeta: Agree. Add `model` field into trace token. Also we should define expiration and replay-window.
mike: Latency tradeoff: validating resume-token may require KV read. Gateway should maintain small in-memory LRU cache of recent tokens to avoid remote calls for hot flows.
elaine: Action items: 1) Spec header format and token semantics 2) Runtime: generate checkpoints + dedupe table 3) Gateway: cache + resume decision logic + strict model-version checks 4) Add e2e tests for duplication/regression. I'll open follow-up PR for the RFC with schema and sample code.
sangeeta: :thumbsup: I'll draft HMAC/KMS integration section for the PR.
jasper: Can we add a metric `stream_resume_attempts` and `stream_resume_duplicates`? We should track regressions.
mike: Also consider a config flag to disable resume per-tenant if privacy/consistency concerns.
elaine: Good point. We'll include tenant-level opt-out and a default-off rollout.

mike: :thinking_face:
elaine: Thanks all — will ping when PR's up.
